summary: Tested backend grade visibility (pytest tests/test_l01_grade_visibility.py 14/14 pass, API /api/dashboard for sales has no 'grade' key, ALICE KNIT variants no longer end with ' | A') and the UI changes on desktop (1920x900) + mobile (390x844) as the sales user. Most requirements PASS. Two issues found: (A) a raw JSX comment is rendering as plain text inside the sales POS quickview (ProductQuickView.jsx line 233), (B) scroll restore from a Lainnya 'Fitur lainnya · tampilan penuh' entry does not work — pressing back ('Kembali ke aplikasi HP' / mobile-back-to-app) lands the user on the Beranda tab with window.scrollY=0 instead of returning to the Lainnya tab at the previous scroll position.

ui_bugs.issue: Line 233 '/* Qty + Satuan (FIXED ke base_unit — F2 UoM SSOT) */' is not wrapped in JSX braces, so it renders as literal text inside every product quickview on desktop POS.

After opening a Lainnya entry (e.g. mobile-full-logistics 'Pengiriman') and tapping back (mobile-back-to-app / 'Kembali ke aplikasi HP'), the mobile app returns to the Beranda tab with scrollY=0 rather than restoring the previous Lainnya scroll position. Switching bottom tabs home→more also returns scrollY=0. The .m-main container has clientHeight === scrollHeight so MORE_SCROLL probably watches el.scrollTop on a non-scrolling container; actual scrolling is on window.

desktop_pos_sales.quickview_roll_lengths_data_testid: quickview-roll-lengths with '150 yd / 50 yd / 150 yd / 50 yd'

mobile_sales.forbidden_items_present: none of Operasi Gudang / PR / Transaksi Antar-PT / Kebijakan Retur / Kasus Keuangan appear

scroll_restore_rca.observed: window.scrollY=889 before navigation; after mobile-back-to-app window.scrollY=0 and the bottom-tab UI shows Beranda highlighted.
scroll_restore_rca.root_cause_hypothesis: MobileMore.jsx tracks scroll on .m-main (MORE_SCROLL) but on sales mobile the actual scrolling element is the window, not .m-main (its clientHeight === scrollHeight === 1677). So the saved scrollTop is always 0 and never restores. Separately, the back-to-app flow routes to the Home tab rather than restoring the active tab=more.
scroll_restore_rca.mitigation: Capture scroll from window (or whichever ancestor is actually scrollable) and restore both the active bottom tab and the scroll position after mobile-back-to-app; or make .m-main the overflow-y:auto container so el.scrollTop reflects reality.

action_items: Fix ProductQuickView.jsx line 233: wrap the comment in {/* ... */} or delete it to prevent it from rendering as text in sales POS quickview.

Fix mobile scroll restore so returning from a Lainnya full-view entry (mobile-back-to-app / 'Kembali ke aplikasi HP') restores (a) the Lainnya tab as active and (b) the previous scroll position. Current MORE_SCROLL reads .m-main.scrollTop which is always 0 because window is the scroll container.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/components/ProductQuickView.jsx:233 — unbraced JSX comment leaks to UI.
MobileMore scroll restore logic likely binds to the wrong scroll container on sales mobile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Grade visibility backend fully correct. Sidebar renames (POS/R&D) and 'Sample' text are already live. RollPicker uses yd/kg only (no dual m display). Two UI defects remain: (1) stray '/* Qty + Satuan ... */' text visible in desktop POS quickview, (2) Lainnya scroll restore broken because .m-main isn't the actual scrolling container; back button also returns to Beranda tab instead of Lainnya.
rca of the issue: See scroll_restore_rca above and ProductQuickView.jsx:233 unbraced comment.
